name: Inpweb Ad Spaces
author: Inp-web

sections.description:
Inpweb Ad Spaces is the professional tool for website owners who want to monetize their traffic by selling banner spaces directly.

Manage everything from an elegant dashboard and display your ad slots anywhere using simple shortcodes. When a visitor clicks “Advertise here”, they are redirected to your WhatsApp with a pre-filled message, allowing you to close the deal manually and fast.

Free Version Features

  • Modern Dashboard: Clean interface to manage your business.
  • Shortcode Integration: Display ads easily using [inpweb_espacio tipo="lateral" id="L1"].
  • Direct WhatsApp Connection: Instant communication with your potential advertisers.
  • Premium CSS: High-conversion ad box designs.
  • Expiration Control: Manually manage when an ad should be hidden.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inpweb-ad-spaces folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Access the “Ad Spaces” menu.
  4. Enter your WhatsApp number in Settings.
  5. Use the shortcode to start selling spaces.
sections.faq:
Can I accept credit cards?

In the Lite version, sales are handled via WhatsApp. For automated Stripe payments, you need the PRO version.

How many spaces can I create?

Unlimited! Just use different IDs in the shortcode (id=”L1″, id=”L2″, etc.).
